pages.title: Home - Re-Elect Claudia Balducci for King County Council Dist. 6
paragraphs: “I’m running for re-election because I believe deeply that local government can make life better for the people we serve.

My public service has been dedicated to delivering results in transportation, housing, public safety, environmental protection, parks and trails, and access to arts & culture; and I’ve seen firsthand that when we focus on outcomes, work together, and stay accountable to the people we serve, real progress is possible.
That’s the leadership I’ll continue to bring to King County District 6.”
“I’m running for re-election because I believe deeply that local government can make life better for the people we serve.

My public service has been dedicated to delivering results in transportation, housing, public safety, environmental protection, parks and trails, and access to arts & culture; and I’ve seen firsthand that when we focus on outcomes, work together, and stay accountable to the people we serve, real progress is possible.
That’s the leadership I’ll continue to bring to King County District 6.”

Last week’s kickoff was one of those moments that leaves you feeling deeply grateful. Looking around the room, I saw people from every part of King County and every part of my life in public service — labor leaders, housing advocates, transit champions, business owners, arts & ... culture leaders, parks champions, community partners, friends, neighbors, and people who simply care deeply about making government work for the people it serves. That broad coalition means so much to me because it reflects how I’ve always tried to lead: by bringing people together, doing the hard work, and staying focused on delivering real results for our communities. Thank you to everyone who showed up, supported, volunteered, donated, and continues to believe in this work. I truly do not take it for granted. As filing week came to a close, I also learned that I am running unopposed for re-election to the King County Council. It is an honor to serve District 6, and know that I will continue to serve with the commitment, energy, and accountability that this role deserves. There is still so much work ahead — on affordability, housing, transit, public safety, climate resilience, and making sure local government is responsive and effective for the people who rely on it every day. I’m excited and ready to keep doing the work together.

I’m so thankful for the growing coalition supporting this campaign, including labor partners, environmental advocates, and community leaders who care deeply about making progress for our region. These endorsements reflect what I believe: we get the best results when we work together. ... I’m proud of what we’ve accomplished—and ready to keep building on it for District 6.

From concept to reality - almost 20 years in the making! Light rail across the lake is now here! In 2008, when we started working on this project, our kiddo Victor was little, and light rail across Lake Washington was still just an idea. This weekend, Victor, who is now 20, and I ... stood together and watched that idea become real. I've spent the better part of my professional life working, and sometimes fighting, to make this happen. You could say this train is my "other baby" 🙂 This project exemplifies how local government can dramatically improve people's lives when we do our job - delivering real connections, real access, and real opportunity. And we did it! My deepest gratitude to all the thousands of people who made this all possible. I'm excited for what we can do together next!

pages.title: Priorities - Re-Elect Claudia Balducci for King County Council Dist. 6
paragraphs: Over the past decade of Claudia’s leadership on County Council, District 6 has seen extraordinary progress, from delivering light rail and expanding regional trails, to opening the Eastside’s first suite of emergency homeless shelters, to securing major investments in housing, transportation, environmental protection, education, parks, trails, and arts & culture.

Claudia is impactful because she focuses on outcomes . She knows how to turn big ideas into real projects, and how to bring cities, community organizations, labor, and the private sector together to get hard things done.

Now, Claudia is ready to lead District 6 through its next chapter, both the opportunities that come with light rail opening and growing communities, and the challenges of affordability, safety, and climate resilience . If re-elected, she will continue to lead with diligence, urgency, and accountability to deliver a hopeful future for everyone.

In an increasingly expensive region, Claudia will make it a top priority to address the increasing cost of living, including making housing and utilities less prohibitive, so that people can afford to build a future in East King County.

With light rail opening across I-90 and beyond, Claudia will focus on strong bus connections, safe and accessible streets, and continued investment in roads and regional trails so everyone can benefit from our growing transit system.

A recognized regional leader on housing, Claudia will keep pushing to expand housing options at all income levels — so seniors can age in place and working people and families can afford to live near jobs, schools, and transit.

A former public safety official, Claudia is uniquely situated to advocate for a safer county. She will focus on transit safety, supporting victims and survivors, and practical, proven approaches to make public spaces safe and welcoming for all.
Claudia will continue to lead on climate action, clean water, and environmental protection — with a focus on accountability and real, measurable results.

Claudia believes strong communities need shared spaces for healthy activities, connection and creative life, and she will keep expanding access to parks, trails, open space, arts, culture, and historic preservation sites.
At a time of declining trust in government, Claudia remains committed to transparency, strong oversight, and ethics, making sure public dollars deliver real value and achieve the ends voters expect.

pages.title: About Claudia - Re-Elect Claudia Balducci for King County Council Dist. 6
paragraphs: Claudia Balducci is a housing and transportation champion, a lifelong public servant, and a mom. For more than two decades, she has driven transformative change in the region—expanding opportunity, standing up for the most vulnerable, and delivering on the issues that matter most.
LEADING THE COUNTY THROUGH CRISIS —AND BEYOND
AFFORDABLE HOUSING FOR INCLUSIVE COMMUNITIES
A VISION FOR INCLUSIVE, VIBRANT COMMUNITIES

Claudia’s commitment to public service runs deep. Raised in a family of dedicated workers—her mother a teacher, her brother a firefighter, and her stepfather a court officer—Claudia learned early the value of community and local government. She put herself through college and law school with scholarships, loans, and side jobs. She also studied abroad at Oxford University where she played on the Oxford women’s basketball team.

Her legal career began at the Northwest Women’s Law Center (now Legal Voice), where she fought discrimination against women and LGBTQ+ people, defended reproductive rights, and supported survivors of domestic violence. She continued her advocacy as a labor lawyer and volunteered with organizations like the Refugee Women’s Alliance, always standing up for working families and vulnerable communities.

Claudia’s political journey began in East Bellevue, where she advocated for expanding housing and economic opportunity in her own neighborhood, ultimately founding her local neighborhood association. That grassroots leadership led her to serve three terms on the Bellevue City Council, including a term as Mayor.

As Mayor, she stood up to entrenched interests and won tough battles to bring light rail to Bellevue, open the city’s first emergency shelters, and expand affordable housing. She is credited with helping create the first-ever permanent supportive housing and men’s shelter on the Eastside.
LEADING THE COUNTY THROUGH CRISIS —AND BEYOND

In 2015, Claudia was elected to the King County Council after defeating a long-term Republican incumbent. Her reputation for driving policy, building coalitions, and getting results led her peers to elect her Chair of the Council in 2020—just before King County became ground zero for the pandemic. Under her leadership for the first three years of COVID, the Council maintained critical services, protected public health, and supported communities through an unprecedented crisis.
AFFORDABLE HOUSING FOR INCLUSIVE COMMUNITIES

As Founder and Chair of the Regional Affordable Housing Committee and a former Governing Board Member of the King County Regional Homelessness Authority, Claudia has been a driving force in addressing housing affordability. Her efforts have already resulted in thousands of new affordable homes, with plans to develop hundreds of thousands more, ensuring that King County remains a place where people of all backgrounds—including students, working families, seniors, LGBTQ+ people, immigrants, and Black, Indigenous, and people of color—can find a home.

A lifelong transit rider known as a “transit die-hard,” Claudia is one of the most effective transportation leaders in the region. She’s widely credited with delivering light rail to East King County—first fighting to route it through Bellevue and later leading the push to open the 2 Line early.

As Vice Chair of the Sound Transit Board and former Chair of the System Expansion Committee, Claudia has led multibillion-dollar transit expansion across the region, while also advocating for bus rapid transit, pedestrian safety, and infrastructure improvements like Eastrail, a 42-mile regional trail that will connect the Eastside from Renton to Woodinville. She is the leading voice at Sound Transit for reform to deliver regional mass transit faster and more efficiently.
A VISION FOR INCLUSIVE, VIBRANT COMMUNITIES

Claudia believes King County should be a place where everyone—students, workers, families, and seniors—can live, thrive, and belong. As Director of the Department of Adult and Juvenile Detention, she led major reforms to improve the treatment of inmates in our County’s main jail, including physical and mental health services.

Her unwavering support for programs like Best Starts for Kids and the Puget Sound Taxpayer Accountability Account (PSTAA) has helped create more equitable educational opportunities for youth and families across King County. Claudia also spearheaded initiatives that elevate arts, culture, science, and heritage, including the “Doors Open” program, which is expanding access to cultural resources countywide.

Claudia lives in Bellevue with her husband Jim, their kid Victor, and their dog Angel. She continues to be an active community member and brings an open-door, collaborative approach to government. With every role she’s taken—from jails director to mayor to council chair—Claudia has brought people together, built coalitions, and delivered real results.

paragraphs: “ Teresa Mosqueda is exactly the fighter we need in this moment for working people and poor people across our region. She’s shown over and over again how effective she is in passing strong policies that give real opportunity to working people, from expanding labor protections for domestic workers who have been left out of labor laws to passing Seattle’s largest progressive revenue source to funding affordable housing and Green New Deal priorities. She understands what is at stake for our democracy, and will stand up to the authoritarian overreaches of this Administration while ensuring our region remains a welcoming home for everyone.”

“ Teresa has led the way for policy that supports our essential workers, women, and communities of color. I’m proud to endorse Teresa for King County Council, where I know she will continue to stand up for progressive policy that moves us and our region forward.”

“ I'm endorsing Teresa Mosqueda for King County Council District 8 because we need her experience to continue pushing for equitable and just progress for all people who call our beautiful region home. Teresa knows what it takes to organize, fight for, and win essential rights for workers, families, and our most vulnerable neighbors.”

“ I support Teresa Mosqueda in her race for King County Council District 8 because she's shown us who she is on a daily basis: someone who stands up for and with communities pushed to the margins, communities of color, and workers. She's a champion for progressive policy, an incredible organizer, and an elected we can trust to stand up for us — always.”

“ Teresa is a fierce fighter for workers rights and community protections. I am thrilled to endorse her in her race for reelection to King County Council as we stand up to growing fascism and fight to secure greater economic prosperity for all.”

“ Teresa Mosqueda has always led with heart and a deep understanding of what keeps our communities healthy and safe— stable housing, food security, childcare, and access to good jobs. These are the upstream investments that stop people, especially our kids, from ever ending up in the criminal justice system in the first place. As someone who has spent my career focused on prevention and justice, I know how important that work is. I am proud to support Teresa for King County Council District 8, and I hope you’ll join me.”

We know representation matters and what matters most is that the representation is someone who aligns themself with community-centric, labor-forward values. That's Teresa! She's a strong Latina, a change-maker, and fierce advocate for the people.”

“ Teresa Mosqueda knows the difference unions make for workers, which is one of the many reasons we endorse her in this race! “ Teresa Mosqueda has always been a champion for working families. She listens to workers, fights alongside workers, and delivers results that improve people’s lives—from stronger labor protections to investments in child care, housing, and public health. We are proud to stand with her because she never stops standing with us.”

“ Teresa Mosqueda is the leader we need to help families and individuals live healthy, happy, and productive lives.
